race.touhou.flandre.name: Flandre Scarlet
race.touhou.flandre.description:
The younger Scarlet sister: a 495-year-old vampire who can destroy anything by crushing its "eye" in her hand.

Fast and full of magic, she flies on crystal wings and heals and regains mana from the blood she spills. Sunlight burns her, and rain and water weaken her. Every hit feeds her madness, until it boils over into a frenzy that makes her dangerous up close too.
ability.touhou.kyuu.name: Kyuu-tto Shite Dokan
ability.touhou.kyuu.description: Grabs the "eye" of the creature you look at and crushes it a second later: half its maximum health, and anything below 30% is destroyed outright. Sneak to destroy the blocks you look at instead.
ability.touhou.laevateinn.name: Taboo "Lævateinn"
ability.touhou.laevateinn.description: Swing a blade of fire through a wide arc in front of you, burning everything it cuts.
ability.touhou.cranberry_trap.name: Taboo "Cranberry Trap"
ability.touhou.cranberry_trap.descriptio: Shrinking rings of bullets close in around you, slowing and hurting whoever is still inside. Then the trap snaps shut, drags everyone to you and bursts.
ability.touhou.kagome_kagome.name: Taboo "Kagome, Kagome"
ability.touhou.kagome_kagome.description: Cages every enemy around you in place and chains them to you. When the chains run out, they snap shut.
ability.touhou.starbow_break.name: Forbidden Barrage "Starbow Break"
ability.touhou.starbow_break.description: Stars rise from you, then rain around the spot you look at: fifteen of them, each bursting where it lands.
ability.touhou.and_then_will_there_be_no: Secret Barrage "And Then Will There Be None?"
Vanish for five seconds, invisible and untouchable, while bullets fill the area around you. Then it all bursts.
ability.touhou.qed_495_years_wave.name: QED "495 Years' Wave"
ability.touhou.qed_495_years_wave.descri: Three waves roll out from you: the first throws everyone away, the second drags them back, the third flings them into the air.
ability.touhou.bat_form.name: Bat Form
ability.touhou.bat_form.description: Turn into a bat: tiny and quick, and flying costs no mana, but your hits do nothing. Use again to turn back.
ability.touhou.vampire_bite.name: Vampire Bite
ability.touhou.vampire_bite.description: Lunge at the creature you look at, up to 8 blocks away, and bite it if you reach it: you heal as much as you deal, and it bleeds.
ability.touhou.four_of_a_kind.name: Taboo "Four of a Kind"
ability.touhou.four_of_a_kind.descriptio: Split into four. Three copies of you appear around a point ahead, each turned a quarter further, and move as you move. They copy your abilities and attacks at half strength and pull enemies off you, for 20 seconds or until broken.
